en.metaTitle: Roman Numeral Converter – Convert Numbers to Roman Numerals & Vice Versa
en.metaDescription: Free two-way Roman Numeral Converter: convert Roman numerals to numbers (Arabic) and numbers to Roman numerals instantly with expansion breakdown.
en.description: Two-way Roman numeral converter: convert numbers to Roman numerals and Roman numerals to numbers with additive/subtractive breakdown.
en.shortDescription: Convert numbers to Roman numerals and Roman numerals to numbers.
en.intro: Convert standard decimal numbers to Roman numerals or decode Roman numerals into numbers instantly.
en.formulaDescription: Convert between base-10 numbers and Roman symbols by matching thousands (M), hundreds (C, D), tens (X, L), and units (I, V).

stepByStep.title: Enter Value
stepByStep.instruction: Type an Arabic number or Roman numeral.

stepByStep.title: Convert
stepByStep.instruction: Click Convert to view the translation and additive expansion.

workedExample.title: Example: Convert 2026
workedExample.scenario: Convert the year 2026 into Roman numerals.
workedExample.calculation: 2000 = MM, 20 = XX, 6 = VI. MM + XX + VI = MMXXVI.

faqs.question: How do you convert numbers to Roman numerals?
faqs.answer: Break down the number into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones, then replace each part with its corresponding Roman numeral symbol.

faqs.question: What is 2026 in Roman numerals?
faqs.answer: The year 2026 is written as MMXXVI (MM = 2000, XX = 20, VI = 6).
